metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a vote against the wagon, a glass given, and a pain you called a city at nine.

yesterday: The house plays on till Saturday the twenty-sixth, rests in August, and opens again on Monday the twenty-fifth of August. The question is looked at again on the seventeenth.
Five shillings was the country figure on John's sheet.
You said the August rest suits you better than it suits the hired men.
Richard has the pearwood glass. Augustine sang. Agnes forgave the slate for one night. You rose at nine.
